# Isolated beta.3 visual fixture

Displays all 17 added crops, four stages for berries and representative flowers,
and three automatic machines with real 600/900-tick cycles and chest export.
Hotbar items select the overview, stage rows, manual berry harvest and automatic
machine views. Plant/soil items are real vanilla items.

The static growth comparison rows use an artificial 600000-tick duration in the
fixture NBT to keep intermediate stages visible during screenshots. Mature manual
displays retain their harvest. These comparison rows do not measure growth time.
The separate manual berry harvest and automatic machines use production durations.
Exact timings, fertilizer and all crop yields are checked by the server suite.
